Demonstration for IoT constellation.
Description

The ladybeetle series will be used to test a closed-loop system for the Internet of Things (IOT), which includes satellites, cloud computing platforms, ground control stations and terminals. Equipped with remote sensing cameras, open data resources for primary and secondary schools, and is used for aerospace science education
